paths.database_home.description: Directory where GNUnet stores its SQLite databases.

paths.dht_data_dir.description: Directory for DHT persistent data (blocks and index).

paths.zonekey_dir.description: Directory containing GNS zone signing keys.

services.resolver.enabled.description: Enable the DNS resolver service to allow resolution of .gnunet domains.

services.nat.enabled.description: Enable NAT traversal helpers to support peers behind NAT/firewalls.

services.nat.force_local.description: Force internal (RFC1918) addresses to be used for communication (for testing only).

services.peerinfo.enabled.description: Enable peer information service to share and discover peer metadata.

peerinfo.trusted_peers.description: List of peer identities (base32-encoded) that are trusted to sign certificates.

transport.plugins.description: List of network transport plugins to enable. Common: tcp, udp, http, https.

transport.plugin_configs.description: Per-transport configuration: port, listen (bool), and optional bind_to address.

port.description: Port to bind or connect to.

listen.description: Whether to accept inbound connections on this transport.

bind_to.description: IP address to bind to (e.g., 127.0.0.1, 0.0.0.0); leave empty for all interfaces.

services.ats.enabled.description: Enable Automatic Transport Selection for dynamic bandwidth allocation and path selection.

ats.wan_quota_in.description: WAN inbound bandwidth quota in bytes per second (e.g., 100 KiB/s).

ats.wan_quota_out.description: WAN outbound bandwidth quota in bytes per second.

services.vpn.enabled.description: Enable the VPN service to route traffic through GNUnet tunnels (requires kernel support).

services.tun.enabled.description: Enable TUN interface to route IP traffic over GNUnet (experimental).

services.consensus.enabled.description: Enable consensus service for distributed agreement (used by DHT, FS, etc.).

services.dht.enabled.description: Enable the DHT (distributed hash table) for key-value lookups.

dht.debug_no_disk.description: Disable disk persistence for DHT data (for testing or memory-only operation).

services.fs.enabled.description: Enable GNUnet file-sharing (anonymously publish and retrieve files).

fs.default_namespace.description: Default namespace for publishing (e.g., 'public', 'private', or custom namespace name).

fs.search_timeout_ms.description: Default search timeout in milliseconds (e.g., 30000 = 30 seconds).

fs.max_concurrent_searches.description: Maximum number of concurrent file searches allowed.

services.identity.enabled.description: Enable identity service to manage local peer identity.

identity.default_name.description: Default name for the local peer identity (used for logging and UI).

services.revocation.enabled.description: Enable cryptographic key revocation service (advanced, rarely needed).

services.set.enabled.description: Enable social set operations (e.g., private set intersection for contact discovery).

services.gns.enabled.description: Enable GNU Name System — a decentralized, DNS-compatible naming layer.

gns.cache_enabled.description: Enable DHT caching for GNS records to improve lookup performance.

services.nse.enabled.description: Enable Network Size Estimation — helps peers estimate total network size.

services.statistics.enabled.description: Enable local statistics collection (used by GTK UI and CLI tools).
